description: Edit style/layout of an existing table (located by any cell’s text): cell padding (pt), background color (hex), cell borders, column widths (pt), and pinned header rows. scope selects which cells padding/background/border hit — table (default), row, column, or cell (the row/column of the matched cell). Fixes e.g. thin left padding that clips the first letter of cells; border {width:0} makes a table borderless; headerRows repeats the top rows on every page. A direct edit, not a tracked suggestion.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

border.description: cell borders, over the same scope as padding/background

sides.description: which edges to set (default all four)

width.description: points; 0 hides the border (borders cannot be transparent)

cell.description: text of any cell in the target table (locates the table)

columnWidths.description: set specific column widths (points) by column index

headerRows.description: repeat the top N rows on every page (Docs’ "pin header rows"); 0 unpins. Independent of scope.

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

tab.description: Target a specific tab by tabId or title (from list_tabs). Defaults to the first tab.

name: set_table_style
title: Style an existing table
